tagline: Between the reservoirs, a boulder once full of bees.
intro: On Interlake Road, Bee Rock lies between Lake Nacimiento and Lake San Antonio in the Santa Lucia Range. The settlement took its reputation from a fissured granite boulder near Arroyo Alcalde, where nineteenth-century accounts described bees producing hundreds of pounds of honey a year.
Lake Nacimiento is a working reservoir. Its dam holds back winter runoff and lets it go slowly enough to recharge the aquifer that Salinas Valley farming depends on.

moments.title: Oak Shores
moments.text: Oak Shores sits on the north side of Lake Nacimiento, 1,814 feet up in the Santa Lucia Mountains.

moments.title: Lake Nacimiento
moments.text: The lakeside community takes its name from the reservoir, which locals call Dragon Lake for its shape.
